about_the_game:
In a class-based society like the North Aura Kingdom, a lowborn Hayato must rise to protect his village. Alongside his childhood friend Leia, he trains to become a Holy Knight—but other men’s desires threaten her purity.

Will you be able to achieve your goal and protect Leia? Or will you let her pure white body be defiled by other men? It is up to you to decide what fate awaits them at the end of their intense story in this NTR RPG.

Play as Hayato on his dangerous journey to become a Holy Knight.

Blast through enemies with the simple and easy turn based RPG combat system. Progress through the story quickly without the need to level up or thinking about managing your inventory. Gather clues throughout the capital to reach your desired happy ending with Leia, and protect her from being corrupted throughout your journey, or risk seeing her taken into another man's arms.

Gather your wits, trust your intuition, and choose the best choice to protect her... or she will be the one to suffer the consequences. Discover her hidden side by peeking through her memories and heart.

Choice Matters

During your journey, you will have to make choices that will have an impact on the path of the story. Several endings are waiting for you at the end of your journey, make sure to get them all!

Laidback Combat

Breeze through the combat easily by using Hayato and Leia's extraordinary talents and teamwork!

Different Form of Leia's Appearances

Watch Leia's transformation throughout the journey! Several different appearances of your defiled childhood friend are waiting for you to discover!

Reminiscence Room

Relive both of Hayato and Leia's memories and past experiences in the reminiscence room.

Search for Hidden Clues

Search for important clues hidden inside the capital to aid you on your mission as you reach for your desired happy ending!

New Game Plus

Start a new game plus with the option of choosing whether to start from the beginning of the story or from a branching story route.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains nudity and explicit depictions of sexual acts and BDSM between adults.
